create_ConfigAction_for_argparse: create a ConfigAction argparse action to parse key=value config pairs with YAML values
use_ConfigAction_del_prefix: use ConfigAction with del: prefix to mark nested config keys for deletion
use_ConfigAction_set_prefix: use ConfigAction with set: prefix to explicitly set nested config key values
parse_dtype_torch_string: parse a torch dtype string like torch.float32 into a DataType object
parse_dtype_short_name: parse a short dtype name like float16 into a torch DataType object
